policies.full: Rank and accept by full-text cosine.
policies.groupThenMerge: Run adaptive left-to-right sentence grouping, then full-text priority merging.
policies.gate: Require full-text and centroid cosine to reach the cutoff. Rank by full-text cosine.
policies.minimum: Use the lower of full-text and centroid cosine for both ranking and cutoff.
policies.mean: Use the arithmetic mean of full-text and centroid cosine for both ranking and cutoff.
